title: Energy Level Diagram
description: Essential Criteria: The energy levels for n = 1, 2, 3 must be correctly sketched with appropriate quantum number labels.

title: Transition Sketch
description: Important Criteria: Allowed electric dipole transitions between levels should be clearly indicated with the correct selection rules stated.

title: Clebsch-Gordan Coefficients
description: Essential Criteria: The derivation of the Clebsch-Gordan coefficients for the p state must be correctly presented.

title: Full Wave Functions
description: Essential Criteria: The full wave functions for all four n = 2 states must be accurately written in terms of the radial and angular wave functions.

title: Selection Rules
description: Important Criteria: The selection rules used for the transitions must be correctly stated and justified.

title: Fine Structure Explanation
description: Optional Criteria: A brief explanation of how fine structure affects the energy levels could enhance the response.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Missing or incorrect quantum number labels on energy levels will result in a deduction.

title: Transition Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Incorrectly drawn transitions or failure to follow selection rules will lead to a deduction.
